name: UI: scope the composer draft to the chat that owns it (no draft in new-chat composers)
description:
Fix a real cross-chat leak introduced by the draft feature. client/src/components/chat/ChatInputBox.vue takes an optional `chatId` prop and, when the parent does not pass it, falls back to $chats.activeChat?.id for the unsent draft (GET/PUT/DELETE /chats/draft, debounced PUT while typing). FOUR of the six parents are NEW-CHAT composers that have no chat yet and do not pass chat-id: client/src/views/QuickChatView.vue (L100), client/src/components/kanban/board/BoardQuickChat.vue (L93), client/src/components/management/ManagementQuickChat.vue (L95) and client/src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue (L125, creating a task chat). Consequence: text typed while creating a task is persisted as a draft INSIDE THE CURRENTLY ACTIVE UNRELATED CHAT, which can then be hydrated by that chat's composer or overwritten. Required changes: (a) in ChatInputBox.vue remove the activeChat fallback - enable persistence ONLY when an explicit chatId prop is provided (a computed like draftChatId = this.chatId || null, and every draft path guarded by it: no GET on mount/switch, no debounced PUT, no DELETE when there is no chatId); (b) in client/src/components/chat/Chat.vue pass the owning chat explicitly: :chat-id="chat && chat.id" on the <ChatInputBox> at ~L201; (c) leave the four new-chat composers WITHOUT chat-id on purpose - add a short comment there or in ChatInputBox explaining that a composer that is creating a chat has no draft, so it must never write into the active one. Keep the change minimal: no reformatting, no renaming of props/stores/routes. DO NOT call project_map / project_locate / project_trace: the atlas TIMES OUT after 120s here and burns the turn (three earlier workers failed exactly that way); read the files directly with project_read_file. VERIFY the build if you have the docker_exec tool: container_name=codx-junior-client, command=/home/codx-junior/.nvm/versions/node/v24.12.0/bin/node /home/codx-junior/codx-junior/client/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build /home/codx-junior/codx-junior/client --outDir /tmp/vite-build-check-draft --emptyOutDir (the working tree is bind-mounted at /home/codx-junior/codx-junior; node is NOT on the default PATH, use that absolute path). If you have no shell/docker tool, say so explicitly and rely on a careful re-read of the edited regions.

**Acceptance criteria**
ChatInputBox never reads or writes /chats/draft without an explicit chat-id; Chat.vue passes the owning chat id; the new-chat composers (QuickChatView, BoardQuickChat, ManagementQuickChat, SprintBoardModals) do not persist drafts; the vite build exits 0 (paste the tail of the output) or the step states clearly that no build tool was available; the diff touches only ChatInputBox.vue and Chat.vue.

State must survive a reload.

**What was confirmed before editing**
- `ChatInputBox.vue` declared `chatId` (optional) and `draftChatId()` fell back to `this.$chats.activeChat?.id`, so any composer without an explicit id (QuickChatView home input, BoardQuickChat, ManagementQuickChat, SprintBoardModals "New Task") read/wrote the draft of whatever chat was active.
- All draft paths funnel through `draftChatId` → `hydrateChatDraft` (GET), `scheduleDraftSync`/`syncDraftNow` (debounced PUT/DELETE), `draftWrite`, and the `draftChatId` watcher.

**Changes (2 files only)**

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `client/src/components/chat/ChatInputBox.vue` | `draftChatId()` now returns `this.chatId || null` (no `activeChat` fallback); `scheduleDraftSync()` and `syncDraftNow()` bail out when there is no owning chat (so no GET, PUT or DELETE); prop/comment documents that a new-chat composer has no draft. Existing guards in `hydrateChatDraft()` / `draftWrite()` already cover the remaining paths. |
| `client/src/components/chat/Chat.vue` | `<ChatInputBox>` now receives `:chat-id="chat && chat.id"`, so the real chat composer still persists/recoveres its draft. |

The four new-chat composers are intentionally left untouched (no `chat-id`): they can no longer write into the active chat, which keeps the diff to the two files the step scopes.
